method: stratified random sample; strata = relationship layer; every stratum gets min(15, its size), the rest is split in proportion to stratum size (largest remainder); within a stratum, random.Random('1030:<stratum>').sample over statements sorted by id. Small strata are over-sampled on purpose: use each stratum's weight (population / sampled) for a plant-wide estimate.

strata.rank_label: the items themselves: identity, attributes and other relations
network layer: a drawn line network and what is attached to it
pairwise link: two items on the same drawn line network (the tracer's links)
pipe layer: a pipe segment or junction (what is piped directly to what)
